240-413-5470-8296.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
When the Egg enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
When the Egg enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability, dealing 1 damage to any target
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

522-6972-8227.notablePrerequisites: You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
522-6972-8227.description:
Activate Loot by sacrificing Melira
When Melira dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its static effect.
Resolve the Loot ability, giving Loot -2/-0 until end of turn
Repeat.

1021-6303-6620-6664.description:
Activate Drownyard Temple's second ability by paying {1} due to Convergence of Dominion, returning Drownyard Temple from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel
Activate Drownyard Temple's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Sylvan Safekeeper by sacrificing Drownyard Temple, giving a creature shroud until end of turn.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

4247-6972-7511.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Witch-king
When Witch-king dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Witch-king
When Witch-king dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve both Bloodthrone Vampire abilities from step 1 and 3.
Repeat.
4247-6972-7511.notes: If Witch-king starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 3 instead.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to Shepherd of the Cosmos

333-2730-4247.notablePrerequisites: Kaya's Ghostform attached to Shepherd of the Cosmos.
333-2730-4247.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Shepherd of the Cosmos.
When Shepherd of the Cosmos dies, Kaya's Ghostform triggers, returning Shepherd of the Cosmos from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Shepherd of the Cosmos enters, it triggers, returning Kaya's Ghostform from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Shepherd of the Cosmos
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Shepherd of the Cosmos.
When Shepherd of the Cosmos dies, Kaya's Ghostform triggers, returning Shepherd of the Cosmos from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Shepherd of the Cosmos enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Kaya's Ghostform from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Shepherd of the Cosmos.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability
Repeat.

2438-7084-7892.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Thranduil the Strategist triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

152-2034-5446-7824.description:
Activate Cogwork Assembler by paying {7}, creating two token copies of Esika's Chariot.
When the Esika's Chariots enter the battlefield, their first abilities trigger, creating four 2/2 Cat creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar four times by sacrificing the Cats, adding eight {C}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the Cats and/or target any other artifact using Cogwork Assembler.

1524-4875-5256-5659.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Ilharg.
When Ilharg dies, it triggers, putting itself from your graveyard into your library.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing you to mill cards equal to Ilharg's power, which will cause you to mill Ilharg.
As Ilharg is a Lhurgoyf due to Conspiracy, Disa's first ability triggers, returning Ilharg from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1879-3490-4289-7075.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that has not been tapped this turn.
1879-3490-4289-7075.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, adding {1}.
The creature's ability granted to it by Tale of Katara and Toph triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

261-338-2034-3490.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
261-338-2034-3490.description:
Gain life.
The creature with Light of Promise attached triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Suture Priest triggers, causing you to gain life.
The creature with Light of Promise attached triggers. Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the trigger from the creature with Light of Promise attached, putting a +1/+1 counter on it 
Repeat from step 3.

165-1069-5499-6965.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least three artifacts.
You have at least one experience counter.
165-1069-5499-6965.description:
Activate Daxos the Returned by paying {1}{W}{B}, creating a */* Spirit creature token.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0} due to Puresteel Paladin, attaching it to the Spirit.
Activate the Spirit by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}{W}{W} or {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to Dryad of the Ilysian Grove

1671-4572-5702-6763.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn
1671-4572-5702-6763.description:
Play Simic Growth Chamber. When it enters untapped due to Horizon Explorer, Simic Growth Chamber and Springheart Nantuko trigger.
Holding priority, activate Simic Growth Chamber by tapping it, adding {G}{U}.
Resolve the Simic Growth Chamber trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad of the Ilysian Grove.
Because of the additional Dryad of the Ilysian Grove token, you can play an additional land this turn. 
Repeat.

149-4831-5268.description:
Cast Legolas's Quick Reflexes by paying {G}, targeting Cacophodon.
Activate Cacophodon by tapping it.
Cacophodon triggers, dealing damage equal to its power to itself.
Cacophodon triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat from step 2.

3774-4554-5900-5902.description:
Activate Luxior's first equip ability by paying {1}, attaching it to Teferi.
Activate Lilysplash Mentor by paying {1}{G}{U}, blinking Teferi, which enters the battlefield with ten loyalty counters due to Innkeeper's Talent.
Activate Teferi's third loyalty ability by removing nine loyalty counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

uses.n: Budoka Gardener // Dokai, Weaver of Life

224-1993-3886.easyPrerequisites: You control up to three lands that enter the battlefield untapped and can tap to produce at least {3}.
224-1993-3886.notablePrerequisites: You control nine or fewer lands.
224-1993-3886.description:
Activate three lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}.
Activate Soratami Mirror Mage by paying {3} and returning the three lands from the battlefield to your hand.
Holding priority, activate Budoka Gardener by tapping it, putting a land from your hand onto the battlefield.
When the land enters the battlefield, Retreat to Coralhelm triggers, untapping Budoka Gardener.
Repeat from step 3 two additional times.
Repeat from step 1.
Resolve all Soratami Mirror-Mage abilities, returning any number of creatures from the battlefield to their owners' hands.
224-1993-3886.notes: You can repeat this loop as desired to constantly return creatures to their owner's hands as they enter the battlefield.

813-1567-3617.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana available each turn to cast Time Walk and Momentary Blink.
813-1567-3617.description:
Cast Time Walk by paying its mana cost, taking an extra turn.
Cast Momentary Blink by paying its mana cost, blinking Scholar of the Ages.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Time Walk and Momentary Blink from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

1479-1659-3861.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-1659-3861.description:
Play Orzhov Basilica.
When Orzhov Basilica enters the battlefield, it, Seed the Land, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Orzhov Basilica trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Seed the Land trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Orzhov Basilica from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Orzhov Basilica enters the battlefield, it and Seed the Land trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

2034-2948-6115.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Ozox, adding {C}{C}.
When Ozox dies, it triggers, creating a legendary 2/1 Jumblebones creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Jumblebones, adding {C}{C}.
When Jumblebones dies, it triggers, returning Ozox from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Initiates of the Ebon Hand by paying {1}, adding {B}.
Cast Ozox by paying {2}{B}.
Repeat.

457-2538-4009-5390.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three artifacts.
457-2538-4009-5390.description:
Cast Mox Opal by paying its mana cost.
Forensic Gadgeteer triggers, creating a Clue token.
Activate Urza's first ability by tapping the Clue, adding {U}.
Activate Mox Opal by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Words of Wind by paying {1}, replacing the next card you would draw by causing each player to return a permanent to their hand instead.
Activate the Clue by paying {1} and sacrificing it, causing you to return Mox Opal from the battlefield to your hand, and causing each opponent to return a permanent they control from the battlefield to their hand due to Words of Wind.
Repeat.

1621-3504.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Mercurial Pretender.
1621-3504.description:
Cast Mercurial Pretender by paying its mana cost, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Wispweaver Angel
When Mercurial Pretender enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Wispweaver Angel.
When Wispweaver Angel enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Mercurial Pretender. Choose to have Mercurial Pretender enter the battlefield as a copy of Wispweaver Angel.
Repeat from step 2.

1339-5147-5572.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
1339-5147-5572.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Dragon Appeasement triggers, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

654-864-1541-4050-5220.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Eternal Witness, adding {R}.
When Eternal Witness dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Eternal Witness on top of your library from your graveyard.
Cast Hit the Mother Lode by paying {4}{R}{R}{R}, exiling Eternal Witness from the top of your library and casting it without paying its mana cost, and creating seven tapped Treasure artifact tokens.
When Eternal Witness and the Treasures enter the battlefield, Amulet of Vigor triggers seven times and Eternal Witness triggers once.
Resolve all Amulet of Vigor triggers, untapping the Treasures.
Resolve the Eternal Witness trigger, returning Hit the Mother Lode from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate six Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {4}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

437-4222-4474.description:
Activate Sphinx's Disciple by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Sphinx's Disciple.
Sphinx's Disciple triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

12-128-3877-4550.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two cards in hand.
12-128-3877-4550.description:
Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
When the Zombie enters the battlefield, Elemental Bond and Garruk's Uprising's second ability trigger, causing you to draw two cards.
Repeat.

539-3537-4552.description:
Activate Bog Initiate by paying {0} due to Blossoming Tortoise, adding {B}.
Repeat.

152-1283-2719-3129.description:
Activate Chromatic Orrery's first ability by tapping it, adding {5}.
Activate Cogwork Assembler by paying {7}, creating two token copies of Chromatic Orrery.
Activate the Chromatic Orrery tokens' first abilities by tapping them, adding {10}.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite mana, you may instead tap the Chromatic Orrery tokens to draw infinite cards, or target any artifact(s) using Cogwork Assembler's ability.

190-389-1814.description:
Cast Fractured Identity by paying {3}{W}{U}, exiling Nine Lives and causing each opponent to create a token copy of it.
Nine Lives triggers. Holding priority, activate Tranquil Grove by paying {1}{G}{G}, destroying all other enchantments.
Each opponent's Nine Lives leaves the battlefield, causing them to lose the game.

414-2660-3189.notablePrerequisites: You have at least five Insects in library and/or graveyard.
414-2660-3189.description:
Cast Doomsday by paying {B}{B}{B}, choosing any five Insects in your graveyard and/or library, exiling the rest of your library and graveyard, then putting the Insects into your library in any order.
Cast Wheel of Sun and Moon by paying {G/W}{G/W}, attaching it to yourself.
Activate Grist's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, causing you to create a 1/1 Insect creature token, put a loyalty counter on Grist and mill a card.
The card is instead revealed and put on the bottom of your library due to Wheel of Sun and Moon.
Repeat the process, causing you to create a 1/1 Insect creature token, put a loyalty counter on Grist and mill a card.
Because this process will repeat infinitely, the game ends in a draw.

413-1778-2399-3652-4143.description:
Tap Blasting Station, sacrificing Memnite to deal 1 damage to any target.
Colfenor triggers, returning Ornithopter from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Ornithopter.
Ornithopter enters, triggering Blasting Station untapping it.
Tap Blasting Station, sacrificing Ornithopter to deal 1 damage to any target.
Colfenor triggers, returning Memnite from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Memnite.
Memnite enters, triggering Blasting Station untapping it.
Repeat.
